modules.module_title: Develop and maintain caddies at a golf course

pcs.pc_description: recommend workforce requirements for caddying at the golf course

modules.module_title: Conduct golf course and caddies’ readiness check

pcs.pc_description: conduct golf course and caddies’ readiness check
obtain weather forecast, golf course conditions and plan for the day
ensure golf cart, equipment, caddies are adequate to the requirement for the day
identify supervision requirements for the day
identify different game, competition format, categories i.e., men, women, junior and senior for the day
prepare the golf playing environment for both individuals and groups
ensure requirements for health and safety that are relevant to the activities which are being planned

recognize successful completion of work by team members
use information collected on the performance of team members in any formal appraisals of performance

interact (verbal, non-verbal and written) in a gender, disability, and culturally sensitive manner
promote a safe and interactive environment
identify and report inappropriate behaviour (e.g. sexual harassment) to appropriate authority
